hard_disabled_reasons.message: PNC-019 blocks runtime buildability until executable lifecycle certification evidence exists.

captured_plan_complete_buildable_ladder.rule: Captured source, ledger atoms, or preserved lineage are not plan-complete and are not buildable.
Plan-complete docs and green validators are necessary preconditions only.
Buildability requires concrete schemas, command wiring, security boundaries, behavioral acceptance, and clean-room lifecycle evidence.

node_readiness.hard_disabled_reason: PNC-019 executable lifecycle certification is incomplete
node_readiness.status_reason: Plans are indexed with required PlanUnit metadata and the PlanCompile compiler contract is accepted, but native runtime readiness remains blocked by PNC-019 until an executable lifecycle certification harness passes and records evidence for the enabled runtime boundary.

acceptance_to_close: scripts/pm-implementation-readiness.py validate remains pass with this blocker closed.
PNC owner docs name concrete artifact contracts and executable proof routes rather than future inference.
Runtime contract validation includes negative fixtures for missing/placeholder contract materialization.
remaining_open_blockers.notes: Closing this blocker must not create product WorkNodes, NodeSeeds, executable queues, final node manifests, implementation files, or production build tasks.
required_evidence: Concrete payload schemas or discriminator branches for every PlanCompile artifact kind used by the runtime path.
Fixtures proving each artifact kind rejects generic or placeholder payloads.
Trace from ApprovedPlanPack and PlanApproved to PlanCompileRun, WorkGraph draft, WorkNodeRequest, Executor intake, activation, and certification receipts.
remaining_open_blockers.summary: PlanCompile and Planning Wizard contracts are not buildable until every runtime artifact has a concrete payload contract, producer, consumer, validator, receipt, retry route, rollback route, and executable proof path; schema-file existence alone is insufficient.

acceptance_to_close: Owner docs specify persistence owners, keys, transactional boundaries, and replay behavior.
Currentness and idempotency tests prove persistence behavior instead of only schema shape.
Buildability report records closed evidence refs for persistence lifecycle proof.
remaining_open_blockers.notes: This blocker is about runtime persistence evidence only; it does not authorize creating runtime records in this docs lane.
required_evidence: Durable storage lifecycle contract for each buildability artifact and receipt.
Replay and restart fixtures proving the same PlanCompileRun identity is recovered from persisted state.
Idempotency evidence for duplicate Approve And Build delivery and PlanCompile resume.
remaining_open_blockers.summary: Buildability requires durable state, idempotency, transactional outbox, replay/restart, and receipt persistence for ApprovedPlanPack, PlanApproved, PlanCompileRun, compiler waves, Executor intake, activation, testing, and certification; preserved source lineage does not prove persistence behavior.

acceptance_to_close: Planning Wizard and UI wiring docs bind the command to buildability_gate_report.json.
Wiring validation checks disabled reason completeness, not merely row existence.
The buildability gate report is the source for blocker-family and owner-doc disabled copy.
remaining_open_blockers.notes: A passing wiring schema check remains a prerequisite only; it is not behavioral buildability proof.
required_evidence: State projection fixture showing Approve And Build disabled when buildability_gate_passed=false.
Disabled reason fixture listing every open blocker_family and exact owner_docs from buildability_gate_report.json.
Command dispatch fixture proving the disabled control cannot emit PlanApproved or create/bind PlanCompileRun.
remaining_open_blockers.summary: Approve And Build is not buildable from a wiring matrix row or command name alone; the GUI must consume the buildability gate report, keep the control disabled until the gate passes, and show blocker families plus exact owner docs in the disabled reason.

acceptance_to_close: Owner docs name exact permission checks and authority owners.
Negative security fixtures are executed by the clean-room harness.
Buildability gate report records the closed evidence refs and no longer lists security_boundary as open.
remaining_open_blockers.notes: Security readiness cannot be inferred from schema validity or source-lineage coverage.
required_evidence: Permission and actor identity checks for approval, PlanCompile, Executor intake, source-control actions, and provider calls.
Negative fixtures proving unauthorized approval, stale credentials, missing trust, and destructive actions are rejected.
Security boundary receipts tied to PlanCompileRun and GoalCompletionReceipt certification.
remaining_open_blockers.summary: Buildability requires explicit actor identity, permission, source-control authority, trust, destructive-action, credential, and policy boundaries across Planning Wizard approval, PlanCompile, Executor intake, providers, and tests; validator green does not prove those boundaries execute.

acceptance_to_close: Plans/.plan_index/node_readiness_report.json no longer reports blocked_runtime_certification_incomplete.
PNC-019 executable_lifecycle_certification_complete is true with evidence refs.
No indexer, doc edit, or static fixture is used as substitute for executable lifecycle proof.
remaining_open_blockers.notes: This blocker is the hard disabled reason that must always surface in Approve And Build until real lifecycle evidence exists.
required_evidence: Executable PNC-019 lifecycle harness result with positive and negative cases.
Recorded evidence for PlanApproved to PlanCompileRun to Executor intake to activation to queued entrypoint to Orchestrator projection.
Cancellation, restart, idempotency, testing, and negative-case rejection receipts linked to Goal Runtime certification.
remaining_open_blockers.summary: PNC-019 keeps native runtime buildability disabled until an executable lifecycle certification harness proves Approve And Build through PlanCompile, Executor intake, activation, queued entrypoint, Orchestrator projection, testing evidence, cancellation/restart, and negative-case rejection.

acceptance_to_close: Provider stream owner docs name the runtime proof route and evidence refs.
Clean-room harness exercises provider-stream positive and negative cases or marks them explicitly simulated with policy approval.
Buildability gate report closes provider_stream only with concrete execution evidence.
remaining_open_blockers.notes: Current provider version notes remain currentness inputs, not implementation proof.
required_evidence: Provider stream fixture proving requested/effective account, model, auth, cancellation, retry, quota, degraded, and evidence behavior.
Negative fixtures for missing credentials, stale discovery, unavailable provider, and interrupted stream.
Receipts tying provider stream outcomes to PlanCompile stage cards and repair/test evidence.
remaining_open_blockers.summary: Buildability requires provider/model/auth stream behavior, quota/error/degraded-state handling, cancellation, retries, and evidence capture for the providers used by PlanCompile and verification; provider catalog or route documentation alone is not enough.

acceptance_to_close: PlanUnits distinguish lineage-preservation acceptance from behavioral acceptance.
Progression gates block fake or preservation-only acceptance for buildability claims.
Buildability report closes this family only after behavioral acceptance evidence is attached.
remaining_open_blockers.notes: This blocker prevents ledger/source-preservation success from becoming implementation-ready by vocabulary drift.
required_evidence: Behavioral acceptance criteria that name observable outcomes, events, state transitions, failures, and evidence artifacts.
Tests or clean-room scenarios proving preservation-only acceptance is not counted as behavioral completion.
Audit rule that blocks buildability when acceptance criteria only say source atoms were preserved.
remaining_open_blockers.summary: Preservation-only acceptance criteria prove lineage, not behavior. Buildability requires executable behavioral acceptance for user-visible and runtime outcomes, including disabled controls, PlanCompile transitions, tests, failures, and receipts.

acceptance_to_close: Structural checks prove buildability prerequisites, not merely plan-governance shape.
Known import guardrails and owner placeholders are closed or explicitly out of buildability scope.
Buildability report records closed structural evidence refs.
remaining_open_blockers.notes: This blocker does not imply Plans are invalid; it only blocks implementation buildability.
required_evidence: Current dependency and owner-routing audit proving no unresolved implementation owner/doc holes remain.
Executable-order graph proof for buildable units and stage dependencies.
Negative fixtures rejecting empty target docs, placeholder owners, duplicate/generic payloads, and cycle leakage.
remaining_open_blockers.summary: Buildability requires acyclic executable order, no unresolved owner/doc placeholders, no empty target-doc rows, no generic payloads, and no hidden dependency gaps; a valid PlanUnit index or semantic closure registry alone cannot prove this.

acceptance_to_close: Every open or closed blocker row has exact owner docs and no candidate-only owner.
Plan and runtime retrieval exclude source-lineage-only documents as current implementation authority.
Buildability report closes owner_routing only after owner evidence is current.
remaining_open_blockers.notes: Owner hints are not owner decisions.
required_evidence: Owner-routing matrix with exact current owner docs for each buildability responsibility.
Negative retrieval/search proof excluding retired compatibility docs from current implementation authority.
Disabled reasons list exact owner docs from blocker rows rather than generic domains.
remaining_open_blockers.summary: Buildability requires exact owner routing for every runtime, UI, schema, persistence, security, provider, acceptance, and harness responsibility. Candidate owners or compatibility/source-lineage docs cannot be treated as implementation authority.

acceptance_to_close: Currentness fields are verified in execution, not just named in docs.
Stale valid JSON and stale indexes are rejected by behavioral fixtures.
Buildability report records currentness proof refs and removes this open blocker.
remaining_open_blockers.notes: Currentness blocker remains open even when files parse and validators are green.
required_evidence: CAS/currentness fixture proving stale final-review inputs disable Approve And Build and route to refresh.
PlanCompile preflight fixture proving stale PlanUnit, acceptance, testing, project-context, provider, or source-control inputs are rejected.
Receipts recording refresh/revalidation before any PlanApproved or PlanCompileRun creation/binding.
remaining_open_blockers.summary: Buildability requires current PlanningRun, topic map, ApprovedPlanPack, PlanUnit index, acceptance index, testing policy, project context, source-control state, provider discovery, and final audit/closure inputs; stale-but-valid JSON cannot launch or certify a build.

acceptance_to_close: PNC-019 lifecycle harness passes and records evidence refs.
The buildability gate report shows buildability_gate_passed=true only after all other blocker families are closed.
Static scenario lists remain targets, not proof.
remaining_open_blockers.notes: This is the terminal blocker family for clean-room implementation evidence.
required_evidence: Executable clean-room harness report with positive lifecycle cases and all adversarial cases run.
Evidence that rejected cases fail for the expected reason and cannot still emit PlanApproved, PlanCompileRun, WorkNodeRequest, or activation receipts.
Harness receipts linked to PNC-019 and buildability_gate_report.json.
remaining_open_blockers.summary: Static clean-room positive and negative scenarios are certification targets, not certification. Buildability requires an executable clean-room lifecycle harness that runs positive and adversarial cases against the actual command, runtime, persistence, security, provider, UI, and testing boundaries.

validation_status_semantics: The validator passes when this report is current and truthful; buildability_gate_passed is the product gate used by Planning Wizard.
